sources.entry: datastacktv/data-engineer-roadmap: roadmap to becoming a data engineer

summary.one_liner: A 2021 roadmap and study guide that maps the modern data engineering tool landscape for aspiring data engineers.
summary.what_it_does: The README presents a roadmap to becoming a data engineer, described as a complete picture of the modern data engineering landscape meant to serve as a study guide. It includes a note telling beginners not to be overwhelmed, since a typical data engineer masters a subset of the listed tools over several years. The visible text does not list the individual tools or categories; the roadmap itself is likely an image or graphic that the text does not describe. The README also links to the maintainer's Data Stack Jobs site and the datastack.tv screencast tutorial platform, and invites issues and pull requests for suggested changes. Licensing is noted as copyright 2021 Alexandra Abbas.
use_cases: learning the data engineering career path
finding which data engineering tools to study
planning a multi-year data engineer study plan
onboarding into the modern data stack
notable: Framed as a study guide for aspiring data engineers covering the modern data engineering landscape
